antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 980nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in pneumocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Gentle regeneration: 345 THz (870nm) at low power, continuous, targets neuron mitochondria targeting water_lipid_interface in pneumocyte.
